summary: C3is Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing a one-for-forty reverse stock split effective August 19, 2026, to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. Outstanding shares reduce from approximately 57.6 million to 1.44 million; par value remains $0.01. Fractional shares are cashed out at the August 18 closing price. Warrants and Series A Convertible Preferred Stock are proportionately adjusted. This corporate action is routine capital structure maintenance, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply. Watch for Nasdaq compliance status post-split.
